summary: Titled mutual but the definition protects only Vectra Logix, with a one-way IP assignment, German law and Frankfurt exclusive jurisdiction, and a one-way assignment right.

findings.quote: disclosed directly or indirectly by or on behalf of Vectra Logix to Halyard
findings.why: Titled mutual, but the definition of Confidential Information covers only information disclosed by Vectra Logix to Halyard, so Halyard's information is unprotected.
findings.draft_redline: "Confidential Information" means all information disclosed directly or indirectly by or on behalf of either Party (the Disclosing Party) to the other Party (the Receiving Party) for the Permitted Purpose, ... [remainder unchanged].
findings.note_to_counterparty: As this is a mutual agreement, the definition of Confidential Information should protect information disclosed by either Party. Could we amend it so that it applies equally to Halyard's information?

findings.quote: solely, strictly, and exclusively to the extent indispensable for the performance and realization of the Permitted Purpose
findings.why: Use is limited to the Permitted Purpose, a potential business transaction and commercial cooperation between the Parties.

findings.quote: can prove by objective, contemporaneous written records
findings.why: All four carve-outs are present and a written-records standard is acceptable, but requiring contemporaneous records and (3.1.4) no access by the developing staff arguably narrows them; unsure so deviation.
findings.draft_redline: ...the Receiving Party can show by written records or other reasonable evidence:
findings.note_to_counterparty: We are content with the four exclusions but would ask that the evidence standard be 'written records or other reasonable evidence' rather than contemporaneous records.

findings.quote: only to those of its Representatives who have a strict need to know
findings.why: Representatives (directors, employees, advisers, auditors, Affiliates) may receive information on a need-to-know basis with the Receiving Party liable for them; insurers are not listed.
findings.fallback_cited: Requirement for written confidentiality undertakings from advisers who are not under professional duties.

findings.quote: provide the Disclosing Party with prompt written notice thereof as soon as legally permissible
findings.why: Disclosure is allowed where required by court, authority or statute, with notice only where legally permissible and reasonable efforts to secure confidential treatment.

findings.quote: within ten (10) Business Days, return to the Disclosing Party all documents
findings.why: Return or destruction within 10 Business Days, officer or director confirmation, and 6.2 permits legally required copies and automated backups which stay confidential under 6.3.

findings.quote: shall remain the sole and exclusive property of the Disclosing Party or its respective licensors
findings.why: Confidential Information and IP stay with the Disclosing Party, and 7.2 grants no licence beyond evaluation for the Permitted Purpose.

findings.quote: Halyard hereby assigns to Vectra Logix all present and future worldwide right, title, and interest in and to any such developments
findings.why: One-way present assignment to Vectra Logix of IP in Halyard's improvements, derivatives and feedback relating to Vectra Logix information.
findings.draft_redline: Delete clause 7.3. Replace with: Each Party retains ownership of its own Intellectual Property Rights and no assignment of any improvements, derivatives or feedback is made under this Agreement.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Halyard is unable to agree to an assignment of improvements or feedback. We propose that each Party simply retains its own IP and that no licence is granted beyond use for the Permitted Purpose.

findings.quote: Halyard undertakes to execute all such formal declarations, transfer deeds, assignments, and patent application forms
findings.why: Further-assurance obligation on Halyard only, perfecting the IP assignment in 7.3.
findings.note_to_counterparty: As clause 7.3 is deleted, this further-assurance clause is no longer needed.

findings.quote: except in instances of deliberate intent (Vorsatz) or gross negligence (grobe Fahrlässigkeit)
findings.why: Mutual as-is disclaimer with an exception for intent and gross negligence; no express fraud wording but deliberate intent covers fraud.
findings.fallback_cited: Mutual disclaimers in any reasonable wording.

findings.quote: for a term of two (2) years, unless terminated earlier by either Party upon serving thirty (30) calendar days' prior written notice
findings.why: Two year term with 30 days' notice termination matches the preferred position.

findings.quote: for a period of five (5) years following the effective date of such termination or expiration
findings.why: Survival of 5 years is within the 2 to 5 year range, with unlimited protection limited to trade secrets.

findings.quote: shall be entitled, in addition to all other statutory claims for monetary damages or restitution, to seek preliminary and permanent injunctive relief
findings.why: Mutual right (Disclosing Party) to seek injunctive relief, cumulative with other remedies, no bond.

findings.quote: shall be governed exclusively by, and construed in accordance with, the substantive laws of the Federal Republic of Germany
findings.why: Governing law is German law rather than the law of England and Wales.
findings.draft_redline: This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising from it are governed by the law of England and Wales.
findings.note_to_counterparty: Halyard is not able to agree to German law. We propose English law, and would be open to non-exclusive jurisdiction of the English courts.

findings.quote: exclusive place of jurisdiction (ausschließlicher Gerichtsstand) for all disputes, controversies, or claims arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, its formation, or its breach shall be Frankfurt am Main, Germany
findings.why: Exclusive jurisdiction is given to the courts of Frankfurt am Main, outside England and Wales.
findings.draft_redline: The courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We would ask that disputes be heard in the courts of England and Wales; as a fallback Halyard could accept non-exclusive jurisdiction.

findings.quote: provided, however, that Vectra Logix shall be entitled to assign this Agreement without consent to an Affiliate or in connection with a merger, reorganization, or sale of substantially all of its assets
findings.why: Vectra Logix may assign without consent while Halyard needs prior written consent.
findings.draft_redline: Delete the proviso, or make it mutual: either Party may assign this Agreement without consent to an Affiliate or successor on written notice to the other Party.
findings.note_to_counterparty: We would ask that the assignment right be mutual, or that it be removed so that both Parties need consent.

findings.quote: not decompile, reverse engineer, disassemble, decrypt, decode
findings.why: Receiving Party may not reverse engineer software or prototypes.
